content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Clone ## slug: event-clone ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (**Update Your New Event's Total Capacity**) Users must manually update a cloned Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TotalCapacity}} after cloning an Event because cloning an Event resets the new Event's {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TotalCapacity}} to the cloned Event Item’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}}. ::: Need to duplicate your {{variable.Object_Event}} quickly with all of the related information like {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, {{variable.Object_Session}}s, {{variable.Object_Sponsor}}s, {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s, etc? Now you can, in three simple steps with our Clone feature! ## Before You Clone ### Permissions A standard user must have one of the following permission sets to be able to clone Event records. * {{variable.PS_ET_Admin}} * {{variable.PS_ET_Organizer}} * {{variable.PS_ET_CommunityPlatformUser}} ### Page Layout :::(Info) (**Standard Users' Page Layout**) When cloning an Event, standard users will use the default page layout, which includes any Related Lists that may have been removed on the original Event record. ::: The Deep Clone Layout now includes the following fields: {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ConfirmatioEmail}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistedEmail}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlisPendEmail}}. Previously, only the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} was cloned. Installations after March 2024 will include the fields on the Deep Clone Layout; however, existing customers must manually add the fields. Follow the steps below to add the custom fields to the Event Deep Clone Layout. 1. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}}. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Setup}}. 3. Click the Object Manager tab. 4. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Event" (conference360__Event__c). 5. Click the Field Sets tab. 6. Click “Deep Clone Layout." 7. Drag and drop the following fields in the "In the Field Set" list. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ConfirmatioEmail}} (conference360__Confirmation_Email__c) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistedEmail}} (conference360__Waitlisted_Email__c) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlisPendEmail}} (conference360__Waitlisted_Pending_Email__c) 8. To make a field required, hover over the field in the "In the Field Set" box, click the **Wrench** icon, and check the {{variable.Field_EVDeepClone_Required}} checkbox. 9. Click **OK**. 10. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. Finally, confirm that any other fields you want to clone are on our Deep Clone field set. ![Clone Field Sets](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Clone%20Field%20Sets.png){height="" width=""} ## Classic/Lightning 1. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record and click the {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button. To select all objects at one time, click the **Clone All** button. ![Click Clone Button](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Click%20Clone%20Button.png){height="" width=""} 2. Select the Related Items. The right side of your screen will display a list of all related items. Toggle the {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button to select which {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} should also be cloned. Leaving them gray will not clone the {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. * Example: If I wanted to clone the "Speakers" {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} to my new {{variable.Object_Event}}, I would toggle {{variable.Toggle_Active}}. * Example: If I didn't want to clone the "Staff" {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}, I would leave it as {{variable.Toggle_Inactive}}. ![Choose what to clone](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Choose%20what%20to%20clone.png){height="" width=""} 3. Click the {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button. Once you click the {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button, a new {{variable.Object_Event}} will be created. ## Custom Questions (Form) Clone To deep clone forms in lightning experience: 1. Edit the {{variable.Object_Form}} page layout. 2. Add the custom {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button from the previous Mobile/Lightning actions. ![Custom Questions Form](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Custom%20Questions%20Form.png){height="" width=""} 3. Select the {{variable.Object_Form}} to be cloned. Click the {{variable.Button_ETEvent_Clone}} button. The {{variable.Object_Form}} and accompanying questions are cloned. ![Form Click Clone](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Form%20Click%20Clone.png){height="" width=""} ## Add a Custom Field to the Clone Feature ### Lightning 1. Create a custom field ({{variable.Field_ETEvent_RandomField}}) on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object. ![Create Custom Field on Event Object](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Custom%20Field%20on%20Event%20Object.png){height="" width=""} 2. Edit the field set within the {{variable.Object_Event}} object and add the custom field ({{variable.Field_ETEvent_RandomField}}). ![Edit Field Set](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Edit%20Field%20Set.png){height="" width=""} 3. Save the {{variable.Object_Event}} object and clone the {{variable.Object_Event}}. You can now see the custom field ({{variable.Field_ETEvent_RandomField}}) is ready to be cloned. ![Custom Field Ready to be Cloned](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Custom%20Field%20Ready%20to%20be%20Cloned.png){height="" width=""} ## Cloning with Sessions When cloning an {{variable.Object_Event}} with {{variable.Object_Session}}s, the {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}}, {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}}, {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}}, and {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} of the cloned {{variable.Object_Session}}s will reflect the values in the original {{variable.Object_Event}}. If the values will be different for the cloned {{variable.Object_Event}}, please update them while cloning the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ***Important Note:*** The cloning process supports cloning {{variable.Object_Track}}s and {{variable.Object_Session}}s, *but it does not* automatically clone {{variable.Object_TrackSession}}s. Please manually clone {{variable.Object_TrackSession}}s if they are part of your Event. ## Cloning with Fees Cloning an existing {{variable.Object_Event}} with a {{variable.Field_Fee_PaymentProcessingFee}} will result in a cloned {{variable.Object_Event}} that includes the same {{variable.Field_Fee_PaymentProcessingFee}} value. * If the original {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_Fee_PaymentProcessingFee}} field is blank, the cloned {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_Fee_PaymentProcessingFee}} will also be blank. * If a {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} value exists on the original {{variable.Object_Event}}, the cloned {{variable.Object_Event}} will have the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} related to it. The {{variable.Field_Fee_PaymentProcessingFee}} related to the {{variable.Object_Event}} that is being cloned takes priority over the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}}, including empty fields.
